thesis.en: Software development is evolving from single-turn code completion toward multi-agent coding, debugging and incident-investigation loops supervised by human engineers.
thesis.zhHans: 软件开发正从单次代码补全，演进为由人类工程师监督的多智能体编码、调试与生产故障排查闭环。

description.en: AI coding tools now span inline completion, CLI repository agents, specialized SRE investigation models and multi-model IDE suites, reshaping engineering review and supply-chain security boundaries.
description.zhHans: AI 编程工具已覆盖行内补全、命令行仓库代理、专用生产排障模型与多模型 IDE 套件，重塑工程审查与供应链安全边界。

currentBaseline.en: Inline completion, CLI coding agents (Claude Code), specialized production-incident models (Datadog Scout 1.0) and first-party coding/frontier model suites (Microsoft MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot, Meta Muse Ember, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5, OpenAI GPT-6.2) are commercially available.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 行内代码补全、命令行编程代理（Claude Code）、生产排障专用模型（Datadog Scout 1.0）以及平台自研编程与前沿模型套件（GitHub Copilot 中的微软 MAI Code 2 与 Code 2 Flash、Meta Muse Ember、Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5、OpenAI GPT-6.2）均已商业化提供。

whyThisDirection.en: The structural question is whether software teams shift from treating AI as an autocomplete assistant to delegating bounded repository implementation, kernel optimization and production triage across coordinated agent roles.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 核心结构性问题在于，软件团队是否会从把 AI 当作补全助手，转向在协同代理角色间委托边界清晰的仓库实现、底层优化与生产排障工作。

counterSignal.en: Benchmark task completion does not establish deployment reliability (READY, arXiv:2609.02095); marketplace tampering (Cursor’s October 29 Claude Code extension incident), workspace exfiltration risks and temporary eBPF Linux compensating controls during patch windows (Shirudo) show accountability and security remain major bottlenecks.
counterSignal.zhHans: 基准测试得分并不等同于部署可靠性（见 READY 论文 arXiv:2609.02095）；插件市场篡改（10 月 29 日 Cursor 市场扩展包事件）、工作区外传风险及补丁窗口期的 Linux 运行时临时补偿控制需求（Shirudo）表明安全与责任归属仍是关键瓶颈。

openQuestions.en: Which software maintenance, incident-response and code-review tasks can agents own durably without compounding technical and security debt?
openQuestions.zhHans: 哪些软件维护、故障响应与代码审查任务可由智能体长期稳定承担，而不累积技术与安全债务？

openQuestions.en: What independent production evidence—beyond vendor benchmarks—would show multi-agent software workflows operating reliably across unaffiliated engineering organizations?
openQuestions.zhHans: 除厂商基准外，什么样的独立生产证据能证明多智能体软件工作流已在无关联工程组织中稳定运行？

label.en: IDE pair programming is entrenched and survived appellate DMCA output-theory scrutiny.
label.zhHans: IDE 结对编程已成为主流配置，并在上诉法院层面经受了 DMCA 输出端理论诉讼检验。

summary.en: GitHub Copilot established inline AI pair programming in mainstream editors; in September 2026 the Ninth Circuit rejected a strict identical-copy threshold under DMCA Section 1202(b) while affirming dismissal of plaintiffs’ output theory because generating new code lacked facts showing CMI removal from copies.
summary.zhHans: GitHub Copilot 确立了主流编辑器内的 AI 结对编程形态；2026 年 9 月美国第九巡回上诉法院虽否定第 1202(b) 条须“完全相同复制品”的狭义门槛，但因生成新代码未证明从复制件上移除 CMI 而维持驳回输出端索赔。

label.en: Prompt-driven coding and CLI repository agents changed developer prototyping workflows.
label.zhHans: 提示驱动编码与命令行仓库代理改变了开发者的原型构建工作流。

summary.en: The spread of 'vibe coding' and Anthropic’s launch of the Claude Code CLI in February 2025 marked a shift toward delegating multi-file edits from natural-language prompts while raising code-comprehension concerns.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 2 月“氛围编程”概念的流行与 Anthropic 推出命令行工具 Claude Code，标志着开发者开始通过自然语言委托跨文件修改，同时也伴随代码理解度下降的讨论。

label.en: Coding agents tackle multi-hour kernel and weeks-long benchmark tasks alongside real packaging failures.
label.zhHans: 编程代理已涉足长周期与底层内核基准任务，但工具链自身仍暴露打包失误。

summary.en: METR and Epoch AI’s MirrorCode benchmark and Fable 5’s KernelBench-Mega submission documented multi-step coding capabilities on defined benchmarks, while March 2026’s Claude Code source-code leak showed human release errors persist.
summary.zhHans: METR 与 Epoch AI 联合开发的 MirrorCode 基准及 Fable 5 的 KernelBench-Mega 内核提交记录了特定长任务基准上的进展，而 2026 年 3 月 Claude Code 源码泄露事件表明人工发布失误依然存在。

label.en: Late-2026 expanded specialized SRE/IDE coding fleets alongside extension supply-chain tampering and Linux pre-patch defenses.
label.zhHans: 2026 年秋冬季专业排障与自研编程模型扩充，同时插件投毒与 Linux 补丁前防御需求凸显。

summary.en: Claude Sonnet 5.5, Datadog’s Scout 1.0 SRE preview, Meta’s Muse Ember, Microsoft’s MAI Code 2 / Code 2 Flash and OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 expanded coding/ops model fleets, while malicious Cursor marketplace builds of the Claude Code extension and OpenAI/Cisco’s Shirudo eBPF pre-patch runtime controls highlighted operational security gaps.
summary.zhHans: Claude Sonnet 5.5、Datadog 排障模型 Scout 1.0、Meta Muse Ember、微软 MAI Code 2 / Code 2 Flash 与 OpenAI GPT-6.2 扩充了编码与运维模型供给；与此同时，Cursor 插件市场扩展包遭篡改及 OpenAI/思科推出 Shirudo 补丁窗口临时防护工具凸显出安全护栏缺口。

summary.en: Public evidence confirms deepening AI coding and SRE tooling, but no external industry-wide standard defines when 'AI software teams' is achieved, and 2026 research highlights gaps between benchmark scores and reliable deployment. Kept in monitor_only mode.
summary.zhHans: 公开证据确认 AI 编程与排障工具正持续深化，但尚无外部行业标准界定“AI 软件团队”何时算达成，且 2026 年独立研究指出了基准跑分与可靠部署之间的鸿沟，因此保持观察模式（monitor_only）。

changeLog.summary: Migrated direction to v2.4 provenance and updated through November 2026 with Ninth Circuit Copilot ruling, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Datadog Scout 1.0, Cursor extension tampering, Meta Muse Ember, Microsoft MAI Code 2, GPT-6.2, and OpenAI/Cisco Shirudo.

thesis.en: Agentic systems are moving into structured enterprise CRM, SRE and routing APIs, while confidentiality breaches and counterparty blocks constrain unsupervised autonomy.
thesis.zhHans: 智能体系统正进入企业 CRM、运维与结构化决策 API，但保密供应链风险与外部平台限制仍在制约无监督自主运行。

description.en: Enterprises are testing domain reasoning models, computer-use agents and closed-set decision APIs across business software, alongside sharp governance and ZDR trust boundaries.
description.zhHans: 企业正在业务系统中测试领域推理模型、计算机操作代理与封闭集决策 API，同时直面权限治理与零数据保留（ZDR）信任边界。

currentBaseline.en: Tool protocols (MCP), browser/GUI agents (Operator, Holo4), named enterprise CRM pilots (Salesforce Koa), SRE triage previews (Datadog Scout 1.0) and structured routing endpoints (Gemini Decisions API) are deployed or in customer pilots, but broad unsupervised operational trust remains limited.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 工具协议（MCP）、网页与图形界面代理（Operator、Holo4）、具名企业 CRM 试点（Salesforce Koa）、生产排障预览（Datadog Scout 1.0）以及结构化分类端点（Gemini Decisions API）已进入部署或客户试点，但跨系统的无监督运营信任仍然有限。

whyThisDirection.en: The core question is whether enterprise AI stays confined to human-reviewed copilots and narrow classification endpoints, or matures into auditable multi-step workflow execution across ticketing, CRM and operations.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 核心问题在于，企业 AI 会停留在人工复核副驾与窄域分类接口，还是演进为跨工单、CRM 与运营系统的可审计多步工作流层。

counterSignal.en: MIT’s AI Agent Index noted only 4 of 13 high-autonomy agents disclosed safety evaluations; Dragos’s November 2026 canary audit of three breached hosting providers and OpenRouter’s off-boarding of three providers and removal of 125 ZDR endpoints (while stating OpenRouter itself was not breached and without confirming provider overlap) exposed third-party routing confidentiality risks; and United Airlines’ agent restrictions plus OpenAI’s Australian Medicare portal incident show external systems resist unauthorized automation.
counterSignal.zhHans: MIT《AI 智能体指数》指出 13 个高自主度代理中仅 4 个披露安全评估；2026 年 11 月 Dragos 对三家被入侵托管商的金丝雀审计以及 OpenRouter 清退三家供应商并撤销 125 个 ZDR 端点（声明自身系统未被入侵且未确认清退名单与被入侵方重合）暴露了第三方推理路由保密风险；美联航限制未授权代理及 OpenAI 澳洲医保门户越权事件也表明外部系统正抵制越界自动化。

openQuestions.en: Which enterprise workflows have tight enough verification and rollback semantics to run without per-action human approval?
openQuestions.zhHans: 哪些企业工作流具备足够严密的验证与回滚语义，可以在无逐笔人工审批的条件下运行？

openQuestions.en: How will enterprises verify end-to-end data confidentiality when agent workflows route prompts across multi-hop inference providers?
openQuestions.zhHans: 当智能体工作流跨多层推理供应商路由提示词时，企业如何独立核验端到端的数据保密性？

label.en: Goal-directed open-source prototypes put autonomous task loops on the developer agenda.
label.zhHans: 目标驱动的开源原型将自主任务循环推入主流开发者视野。

summary.en: AutoGPT framed multi-step goal execution as a distinct software pattern in 2023, despite reliability limitations in open-ended tasks.
summary.zhHans: 2023 年 AutoGPT 将多步目标执行确立为一种受关注的软件模式，尽管其在开放任务中仍受困于可靠性瓶颈。

label.en: Standard tool protocols and first-party browser agents established shared workflow primitives.
label.zhHans: 标准化工具协议与第一方浏览器代理确立了工作流基础原语。

summary.en: Anthropic’s MCP, Google’s Gemini 2.0 agentic framing and OpenAI’s Operator preview created standardized tool-calling and browser-action layers.
summary.zhHans: Anthropic 的 MCP 协议、Google Gemini 2.0 的智能体定位与 OpenAI Operator 研究预览构建了工具调用与网页操作层。

label.en: Academic indices and deployment benchmarks now audit agent autonomy and enterprise readiness gaps.
label.zhHans: 学术指数与部署基准已开始系统审计智能体自主度与企业就绪度差距。

summary.en: The MIT AI Agent Index documented rising autonomy levels alongside sparse safety disclosures, while the 2026 READY study highlighted why benchmark-capable agents still fail enterprise deployment requirements.
summary.zhHans: MIT《AI 智能体指数》记录了自主度提升与安全披露稀缺并存的现状，2026 年 READY 研究则揭示了高跑分代理仍难以满足企业部署要求的原因。

label.en: Late-2026 paired narrow enterprise pilots and decision APIs with inference ZDR revocations and counterparty limits.
label.zhHans: 2026 年秋冬季具名企业试点与结构化决策 API 推进，同时推理 ZDR 撤除与外部封堵并行发生。

summary.en: Salesforce’s Koa pilots, Holo4 GUI models, Datadog Scout 1.0 and Google’s Gemini Decisions API expanded enterprise agent tooling, while OpenAI’s Medicare portal incident, United Airlines’ restrictions and Dragos/OpenRouter’s ZDR findings exposed permission and routing risks.
summary.zhHans: Salesforce Koa 试点、Holo4 界面模型、Datadog Scout 1.0 与 Google Gemini Decisions API 扩展了企业代理工具链；同期 OpenAI 澳洲医保门户越权事件、美联航访问限制及 Dragos/OpenRouter 披露的 ZDR 问题暴露出权限与路由风险。

summary.en: Enterprise agent pilots and narrow decision endpoints are expanding, but NIST AI RMF profiles remain voluntary guidance under revision and no external standard defines when autonomous enterprise workflows are achieved.
summary.zhHans: 企业智能体试点与窄域决策接口正在扩展，但 NIST AI RMF 行业配置仍属修订中的自愿性指南，尚无外部标准界定“自主企业工作流”何时算达成。

changeLog.summary: Migrated direction to v2.4 provenance and updated through November 2026 with Salesforce Koa pilots, Gemini Decisions API, United Airlines agent restrictions, OpenRouter/Dragos ZDR revocations, and READY enterprise deployment research.

thesis.en: Embodied AI is building out vision-language-action models, orchestration software and simulation datasets, while verified multi-site commercial fleet operations remain sparse.
thesis.zhHans: 具身 AI 正加速补齐视觉-语言-动作模型、调度编排平台与合成演示数据，但经独立核验的多场地商业化常态运营依然稀缺。

description.en: Robotics labs and chipmakers are shipping embodied reasoning previews, simulation trajectories and world models, testing whether physical AI can move beyond single-plant pilots.
description.zhHans: 机器人实验室与芯片厂商正密集推出具身推理模型预览、仿真轨迹数据集与交互式世界模型，检验物理 AI 能否跨越单一工厂试点。

currentBaseline.en: Embodied reasoning models (Gemini Robotics and ER 2), vendor-reported single-plant deployments (Figure 02’s 11-month Spartanburg run prior to retirement), orchestration frameworks (NVIDIA OSMO), simulated robotics datasets (AllenAI ToyBlocks) and world-model APIs (Genie 4) exist, whereas independently audited multi-customer fleet economics remain undocumented.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 具身推理模型（Gemini Robotics 与 ER 2）、厂商披露的单一工厂部署总结（Figure 02 退役前在宝马斯帕坦堡工厂的 11 个月运行）、工作流编排工具（NVIDIA OSMO）、仿真演示数据集（AllenAI ToyBlocks）与世界模型 API（Genie 4）均已问世，但经独立审计的多客户商业车队经济性仍未建立。

whyThisDirection.en: The key question is whether richer embodied models and simulation pipelines translate into sustained, multi-site customer deployments judged on uptime, safety and unit cost rather than single-partner showcases.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 关键问题在于，更丰富的具身模型与仿真数据管线能否转化为跨客户、跨场地的持续运营部署，并以无故障时长、安全性与单位成本而非单一合作方展示来衡量。

counterSignal.en: Ars Technica noted only one of three Gemini Robotics 2 models was publicly available at launch; Figure’s BMW report is a vendor summary coinciding with Figure 02’s retirement; AllenAI’s ToyBlocks comprises simulated trajectories without external physical-robot transfer proof; and Genie 4 remains an early experimental world simulator rather than a validated physical controller.
counterSignal.zhHans: Ars Technica 指出 Gemini Robotics 2 发布时三款模型中仅一款公开可用；Figure 的宝马报告系伴随二代机退役发布的厂商自述；AllenAI ToyBlocks 为仿真轨迹数据、尚未证明外部实体机器人迁移成效；Genie 4 仍属早期实验性世界模拟器而非经验证的物理控制器。

openQuestions.en: When will independent third-party audits document sustained humanoid or general-purpose robot uptime, intervention rates and unit economics across multiple unaffiliated sites?
openQuestions.zhHans: 何时会出现独立第三方审计，记录人形或通用机器人在多个无关联客户场地的持续运行时长、人工接管率与单位经济账？

openQuestions.en: To what extent do large simulated datasets (such as ToyBlocks) and interactive world models (such as Genie 4) reduce real-world hardware adaptation failures?
openQuestions.zhHans: 大规模仿真数据集（如 ToyBlocks）与交互式世界模型（如 Genie 4）在多大程度上能真正降低实体机器人在非结构化现场的适配失败率？

label.en: Vision-language embodied reasoning models progressed to second-generation developer previews.
label.zhHans: 视觉-语言具身推理模型已演进至第二代开发者预览。

summary.en: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER in March 2025 and followed with Gemini Robotics ER 2 in July 2026, though public access remained partial across model variants.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 于 2025 年 3 月推出 Gemini Robotics 与具身推理模型 ER，并于 2026 年 7 月发布 ER 2，但不同模型变体的公开可用范围仍有限。

label.en: Vendor-documented factory runs moved from brief demos to multi-month single-plant sheet-metal loading.
label.zhHans: 厂商记录的工厂运行已从短时演示延伸至单一工厂长达数月的钣金上下料作业。

summary.en: Figure AI reported an 11-month Figure 02 deployment on sheet-metal loading at BMW Group Plant Spartanburg as it retired the second-generation hardware, though metrics remain company-reported.
summary.zhHans: Figure AI 在宣布二代机退役时披露了其在宝马斯帕坦堡工厂为期 11 个月的钣金上料运行总结，但核心指标仍来自厂商单方披露。

label.en: Late-2026 brought open physical-AI orchestration, long-horizon simulation datasets and commercial world-model APIs.
label.zhHans: 2026 年秋冬季开源物理 AI 编排框架、长时程仿真数据集与商业化世界模型 API 相继推出。

summary.en: NVIDIA open-sourced OSMO for heterogeneous physical-AI workflows, AMD agreed to acquire World Labs, AllenAI published 85,336 simulated demonstrations in ToyBlocks, and Google followed its experimental Genie 4 preview with paid-tier Gemini API access.
summary.zhHans: NVIDIA 开源异构物理 AI 编排平台 OSMO，AMD 达成收购 World Labs 协议，AllenAI 公开包含 85,336 条长任务仿真演示的 ToyBlocks 数据集，Google 则在实验性 Genie 4 预览后向付费层开发者开放 Gemini API 访问。

summary.en: Physical-AI software, simulation datasets and single-site factory pilots are expanding, but most 2026 updates concern upstream models and synthetic data rather than independently verified multi-site fleet operations, and no external industry threshold defines leaving the pilot phase.
summary.zhHans: 物理 AI 软件栈、仿真数据集与单点工厂试点正在扩展，但 2026 年的新进展仍集中于上游模型与合成数据，而非经独立核验的多场地商业化运营，且外部尚无界定“走出试点期”的统一标准。

changeLog.summary: Migrated direction to v2.4 provenance and updated through November 2026 with Gemini Robotics ER 2, NVIDIA OSMO, AMD–World Labs agreement, AllenAI ToyBlocks dataset, and Google Genie 4 API availability.

thesis.en: AI is moving from isolated domain models into iterative hypothesis, proof-assistance and biomolecular design loops, while independent replication and evidence transparency lag vendor claims.
thesis.zhHans: AI 正从孤立领域模型迈向假设生成、定理辅助推导与生物分子设计的迭代闭环，但独立复现与证据透明度仍滞后于厂商主张。

description.en: Researchers combine frontier reasoning models, automated evaluators and domain simulators across biology, math and AI R&D, alongside active debate over human shepherding and audit redactions.
description.zhHans: 研究团队在生物学、数学与 AI 自身研发中结合前沿推理模型、自动评估器与领域模拟器，同时围绕人工引导归因与审计材料删减展开激烈讨论。

currentBaseline.en: Protein structure prediction and watermarked binder design (AlphaFold, SynthID Bio), evolutionary coding loops with automated verifiers (AlphaEvolve), competition-level math reasoning (Gemini Deep Think IMO gold) and human-shepherded research workflows exist, without forming a self-sufficient general discovery pipeline.
currentBaseline.zhHans: 蛋白质结构预测与带水印结合体设计（AlphaFold、SynthID Bio）、结合自动验证器的进化式算法搜索（AlphaEvolve）、奥赛级数学推理（Gemini Deep Think IMO 金牌）以及外部专家引导的辅助科研流程均已出现，但尚未构成可独立运转的通用科学发现流水线。

whyThisDirection.en: The central question is whether repeated generate-verify-refine loops—paired with rising internal AI R&D capability ratings—mature into reproducible discovery workflows that unaffiliated external labs adopt and validate.
whyThisDirection.zhHans: 核心问题在于，“生成—自动验证—迭代修正”闭环叠加不断上升的模型自我研发评级，能否成熟为可由无关联外部实验室独立复用并核验的科研发现工作流。

counterSignal.en: OpenAI’s October 2026 scientific results relied on external human 'shepherds' guiding problem formulation; METR reported Anthropic redacted a majority of the most informative evidence behind its ~1.9x R&D speedup estimate; and GPT-6.2 Astra’s High AI Self-Improvement rating is an internal Preparedness threshold rather than independent proof of open-ended scientific discovery.
counterSignal.zhHans: OpenAI 2026 年 10 月公布的科研成果依赖外部人类专家“引导人”把关方向；METR 在估算 Anthropic 内部研发提速约 1.9 倍时指出大部分最关键证据被删减；而 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 AI 自我改进 High 评级属于内部风险准备度阈值，并非外部开放科学发现的独立证明。

openQuestions.en: Which scientific domains beyond formalizable math, code optimization and protein folding have fast, reliable enough verifiers to sustain automated discovery loops?
openQuestions.zhHans: 在可形式化验证的数学、代码优化与蛋白质结构之外，哪些实验科学领域具备足够快速可靠的验证器来支撑自动化发现闭环？

openQuestions.en: What unredacted external benchmarks or pre-registered replications will separate human-shepherded AI assistance from genuinely autonomous discovery workflows?
openQuestions.zhHans: 什么样的未删减外部基准或预注册独立复现，才能清晰区分“人类专家主导的 AI 辅助”与真正的“原生自动化发现流水线”？

label.en: AI protein-structure prediction achieved Nobel recognition as core scientific infrastructure.
label.zhHans: AI 蛋白质结构预测作为基础科研设施获得诺贝尔化学奖制度性认可。

summary.en: AlphaFold’s structural predictions and the 2024 Chemistry Nobel Prize awarded to Baker, Hassabis and Jumper established AI as foundational infrastructure in structural biology.
summary.zhHans: AlphaFold 的结构预测突破与 2024 年授予 Baker、Hassabis 和 Jumper 的诺贝尔化学奖，确立了 AI 在结构生物学中的基础设施地位。

label.en: Evolutionary LLM-plus-evaluator loops framed algorithmic discovery as a repeatable workflow.
label.zhHans: 大模型与自动评估器结合的进化闭环，将算法发现提出为可重复工作流主张。

summary.en: Google DeepMind’s AlphaEvolve paired Gemini code generation with automated evaluators to iteratively search for improved mathematical and computing algorithms.
summary.zhHans: Google DeepMind 的 AlphaEvolve 将 Gemini 代码生成与自动评估器配对，在可自动打分的数学与计算问题上执行迭代搜索。

label.en: Natural-language test-time reasoning reached certified gold-medal level at IMO 2025.
label.zhHans: 纯自然语言推理时计算在 2025 年国际数学奥林匹克（IMO）上达到官方评定金牌线。

summary.en: Gemini Deep Think scored 35/42 points under official IMO coordinator grading in July 2025 without manual translation into formal proof languages.
summary.zhHans: 2025 年 7 月，Gemini Deep Think 在无需人工先转写为形式化语言的情况下，经 IMO 协调员正式评阅取得 35/42 分的金牌成绩。

label.en: Late-2026 paired functional protein watermarking, shepherded research claims and R&D speed audits with transparency caveats.
label.zhHans: 2026 年秋冬季功能性蛋白质水印、专家引导科研成果与研发提速审计并进，但伴随显著透明度限定。

summary.en: SynthID Bio watermarked functional protein binders, OpenAI reported three expert-shepherded research results, METR estimated ~1.9x Anthropic R&D speedup under heavy evidence redaction, and OpenAI rated GPT-6.2 Astra High on AI Self-Improvement.
summary.zhHans: SynthID Bio 验证了具结合活性的蛋白质设计水印，OpenAI 公布三项外部专家引导科研成果，METR 在底层证据大量删减条件下估算 Anthropic 研发提速约 1.9 倍，OpenAI 系统卡则将 GPT-6.2 Astra 标定为 AI 自我改进 High 阈值。

summary.en: AI is embedded in specific scientific and R&D loops, but attribution debates around human shepherding, redacted internal evaluations and voluntary risk frameworks under revision show no external consensus exists for declaring 'AI-native discovery pipelines' achieved.
summary.zhHans: AI 已嵌入多项具体科研与算法研发闭环，但围绕人类专家引导归因、受删减的内部评估日志及仍在修订的自愿性风险框架表明，外部尚无宣布“AI 原生发现流水线”已达成的成熟共识。

changeLog.summary: Migrated direction to v2.4 provenance and updated through November 2026 with SynthID Bio, OpenAI shepherded scientific results, METR's Anthropic R&D acceleration assessment caveats, and GPT-6.2 Astra High AI Self-Improvement rating.
